thread:
maria: Hey folks — saw a spike of client-side 429s from EU region around 11:04. SDKs are getting plain 429 with no useful signal. Can we add clearer head-of-line/backpressure headers so clients can do smart backoff? :thinking:
ken: Yup saw the same in prod metrics. Burst pushed queue length up and the admission controller started rejecting. Lots of small retries made it worse.
infra-bot: Incident detected: fleet-saturation-eu region. Autoscale attempted 2x, capacity shortfall persisted for ~90s.
maria: Proposal: return a short set of headers that convey (a) admit vs queue vs reject, (b) current effective capacity or slot tokens, and (c) optional Retry-After seconds when rejecting. e.g. `X-RW-ADMIT: queued` / `X-RW-QUEUE-POS: 12` / `X-RW-CAPACITY: 0.64` / `Retry-After: 3`
ken: I like explicit states. Can we keep `Retry-After` for strict rejects and a different header to indicate queueing? Clients treat Retry-After as absolute.
maria: Right — Retry-After for reject only. For queueing use `X-RW-ETM` (estimated time to move) or `X-RW-QUEUE-POS` + `X-RW-EST-SLOT-SEC`. But keep names short.
devx-sam: From SDK perspective we need deterministic rules:
- on `X-RW-ADMIT: queued` -> stop immediate retries, poll with exponential backoff starting at 200ms with jitter, up to 5s. Honor `X-RW-EST-SLOT-SEC` if present and clamp.
- on `X-RW-ADMIT: reject` + `Retry-After` -> honor header then backoff/backoff cap.
- on 429 with no headers -> conservative exponential backoff + add random jitter (default jitter 0.1-0.4).
ken: Also surface a client-visible metric for number of consecutive 429s and last admit state so product teams can route requests differently.
ops-ira: On infra side we can emit those headers from admission controller. Implementation notes: admission controller already knows queue depth, per-pool token rate, and per-model slot occupancy. We can compute `X-RW-CAPACITY` as free_slots/total_slots_float (0-1) and `X-RW-QUEUE-POS` as integer. E.g.:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 3
X-RW-ADMIT: reject
X-RW-CAPACITY: 0.12
X-RW-QUEUE-POS: 0
```
or for queueing:
```
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
X-RW-ADMIT: queued
X-RW-QUEUE-POS: 7
X-RW-EST-SLOT-SEC: 1.4
X-RW-CAPACITY: 0.05
```
maria: Nice examples. For queued we return 202 with queued header so clients know request accepted but not started. That avoids hammering. Must ensure queue TTL and a cancel path.
ken: Edge cases: cross-region failover — if EU pool is saturated we should add `X-RW-FALLBACK-REGION: us-west` to advise clients they can retry to a different region if their policy allows. Obviously only when policy allows PII/latency tradeoffs.
devx-sam: SDK patch idea (pseudo):
```
if (resp.headers['x-rw-admit'] == 'queued') {
  wait = clamp(parseFloat(resp.headers['x-rw-est-slot-sec']) || backoff, 0.2, 5.0)
  await sleep(wait * (1 + random()*0.4 - 0.2))
  retry()
} else if (resp.status == 429) {
  ra = parseInt(resp.headers['retry-after'] || 0)
  await sleep((ra || backoff) * (1 + jitter()))
  retryWithCap()
}
```
ops-ira: We'll add `X-RW-TOKEN-BALANCE` in a followup if teams want per-customer token budgeting signals (helpful for reserved capacity). That exposes risk so will be gated behind tenant opt-in.
maria: Can we also emit `X-RW-QUEUE-EXPIRES` timestamp so clients can surface better UX?
ops-ira: Yes we can add `X-RW-QUEUE-EXPIRES` (ISO8601) for queued entries. TTL must be <= queue retention.
ken: Two operational asks: 1) make header names stable across rollout (no churn), 2) docs/SDK examples shipped in devex repo.
devx-sam: I'll prepare an SDK PR with default behavior and an env var to opt into new header handling. Will include feature flag for region fallback.
maria: Thanks — infra, can you add a short changelog entry for admission controller and a sample set of responses we can copy to devx docs?
ops-ira: Will do. Rolling a small change to stage later today behind kill-switch.
ken: Great. Quick follow-up: telemetry — add an event when we send `X-RW-ADMIT: queued` and include pool_id + queue_len so we can correlate client traffic.
infra-bot: Change scheduled: admission-controller headers + telemetry -> stage at 2026-03-18T18:30Z (canary 10%).
maria: Perfect. Saving this thread for the SDK PR link. :thumbsup:
